ev.q: CDC analyzed data collected by the 2015 National Immunization Survey (NIS)
Coverage in 2015 was highest for ≥3 doses of poliovirus vaccine (93.7%)
More than 90% of children were up to date on vaccination against polio
the largest disparities were for rotavirus vaccine (66.8% versus 76.8%)
In all cases, poverty status remained independently associated with vaccination coverage after adjustment for MSA status.
CDC analyzed data collected by the 2015 National Immunization Survey (NIS)
Vaccination coverage in 2015 varied considerably by geographic area
Overall, coverage did not change during 2014–2015.
Coverage remained below the target of 90% for ≥4 doses of DTaP (84.6%)

methods_quotes.q: Logistic regression was used to assess differences among racial/ethnic groups, controlling for poverty status
Statistical comparisons were made using t-tests on weighted data, taking into account the complex survey design.
All coverage estimates are based on provider-reported vaccination histories.
Estimate not available because the unweighted sample size for the denominator was <30
